operating_notes.text: Received orders amounting to a total of ₹70.86 Cr excluding taxes.
Unutilized preferential issue proceeds of ₹94.10 Cr as of March 31, 2026 are parked in fixed deposits with Yes Bank.
Received orders amounting to a total of ₹208.72 Cr excluding taxes from Adani Infra and Udupi Cochin Shipyard.
Subsidiary partnership firm Narhari Engineering Works converted to MEL Heavy Industries Private Limited, holding 99% stake unchanged.
Received orders amounting to ₹96.40 Cr excluding taxes from Princeton Digital Group for power distribution systems, to be executed over 12-14 months.
Paid ₹21.86 Cr principal and ₹9.50 Cr interest for an arbitration award to a sub-contractor in FY26.
Converted ₹4.77 Cr unsecured loan to subsidiary Evigo Charge Private Limited into equity shares, increasing stake to 96.52%.

Received orders and LOI totaling ₹362.34 Cr excluding taxes from Princeton Digital Group (12-15 months execution) and DXDC Chennai Private Limited (4-5 months execution) for power distribution systems.

timeline.summary: Marine Electricals bagged orders worth ₹70.86 Cr for power distribution systems and panels.
Marine Electricals filed the monitoring agency report for the quarter ended March 31, 2026.
Marine Electricals received orders worth ₹208.72 Cr from Adani Infra and Udupi Cochin Shipyard.
Marine Electricals converted its subsidiary partnership firm Narhari Engineering Works into a private limited company named MEL Heavy Industries Private Limited.
Marine Electricals received orders worth ₹96.40 Cr from Princeton Digital Group for power distribution systems.
Promoters Venkatesh Uchil, KDU Enterprises Private Limited, Tanuja Deepak Pudhierkar, and Vinay K. Uchil declared no new share encumbrances on Marine Electricals (India) Limited as of March 31, 2026.
Marine Electricals received orders and an LOI worth ₹362.34 Cr from Princeton Digital Group and DXDC Chennai for power distribution systems.
